name: ALICE: A Large Ion Collider Experiment at the CERN LHC

summary.plain: The collaboration's own full technical description of the finished ALICE detector, published as the LHC was about to start.
summary.technical: 2008 JINST 3 S08002: the standard ALICE detector-paper reference, describing the Inner Tracking System, TPC, TOF/HMPID/TRD particle-identification arrays, PHOS/EMCal calorimeters, the L3 solenoid and the forward muon spectrometer as installed for the LHC's first collisions.
